text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: potential METERING/INGEST drift detected for production billing. Overcharge alerts firing (alert_id=alert-metering-772). Affected metrics: `tokens_ingested_total`, `daily_billing_tokens`. Threshold tripped at ~2026-03-14T03:12:00Z.

oncall-sre-uk: I'm on it — pulling initial graphs. :eyes:

monitoring-bot: Alert details:
- rule: token_count_surge
- window: 5m
- agg: sum(tokens)
- value: +23% vs baseline
- hosts: ingest-worker-[a-f] (primary shard)

alice: seeing the same in query results. Quick check: `SELECT bucket, SUM(tokens) FROM metering.stream WHERE ts >= '2026-03-14' GROUP BY bucket` — bucket 03:00-04:00 is +19% compared to daily avg.

raj: customer-facing note: support is getting emails about 'unexpected usage' from 2 customers in EU. Escalating to payments. @support-lead-jane can you confirm?

support-lead-jane: confirmed 2 customers opened tickets; both flagged unexpected overages. I'll coordinate replies but need engineering root cause first.

billing-team: jumping in. Any recent deploys or config changes to metering or tokenization?

oncall-sre-uk: There was a canary of `metering-ingest v3.4.1` rolled at 02:45 UTC to add dedupe-on-ingest optimization. Canary passed but full rollout started at 03:05 UTC. Correlates with spike. Rolling back canary now to stop further divergence.

sam: rolling rollback command: `kubectl -n billing rollout undo deployment/metering-ingest --to-revision=2026-03-13-1`. Patch applied to shard-a,b,c. Verifying logs.

incidents-bot: Deploy bot: rollback initiated by sam at 2026-03-14T03:20:12Z.

alice: after rollback, tokens_ingested_total back to baseline on shard-a within 6 minutes. Shard-b still 10% high, investigating backlog replay artifacts.

billing-team: hypothesis: dedupe logic change introduced double-counting for batched requests where `message_id` was null -> fallback to generating synthetic id. That duplicates tokens when upstream connector retries.

raj: good find. Can we stop downstream aggregator from consuming the replay queue while we reconcile counts? Suggested temporary mitigation: pause the replay consumer and enqueue reconciler job.

oncall-sre-uk: pausing consumer: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/pause?consumer=replay-consumer-1` -> 200 OK. Reconciler job scheduled: `billing-reconcile --since 2026-03-14T02:30Z --dry-run` then followed by non-dry run after verification.

payments-ops: for customers already overcharged, we should prepare a credit pipeline. I'll open a payments ticket and list affected customer IDs from `billing.usage_events` where delta > 5%.

support-lead-jane: drafting customer comms template now. Will link once ready.

sam: runbook note: PR reverting dedupe change is at https://git.company/repo/pull/489. Will merge hotfix and deploy to prod once reconciler dry-run validated.

alice: reconciler dry-run results: 312 events flagged as duplicate -> projected credit ~ $92 across 5 accounts. Looks scoped.

billing-team: OK to proceed with reconcile run and hotfix deploy. Post-reconcile we'll run full usage re-ingest for the affected windows and re-export billing tables.

oncall-sre-uk: handoff to night oncall @sam scheduled at 2026-03-14T23:00Z. Current status: incident mitigated (rollback + paused replay), partial customer impact (5 accounts affected), next steps: hotfix merge, reconcile run, customer credits, postmortem.

support-lead-jane: thanks — I'll notify the customers with an interim note: apology + we are applying credits; full follow-up after root cause confirmed.

incidents-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents-status: incident-1947654321 (metering-pulse-anomaly) — severity: Sev2, status: mitigated-active, owner: billing-team.

raj: adding timeline and logs to the incident ticket. Will also include query snippets and reconcile output.

billing-team: final note — recommend adding an integration test for message_id-less batched requests and a metric that alarms on sudden change in dedupe_rate.

support-lead-jane: customer comms ready and queued. Will send after credits applied. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre-uk: closing initial pager. Please escalate if new symptoms reappear.

incidents-bot: Pager closed at 2026-03-14T04:43:07Z.
